==Description==
'''U-5''' is a simple rusher that can only be spawned by admins.

==Behavior==
'''U-5''' will play the [https://create.roblox.com/store/asset/1846862303/Horror-Race Horror Race Song] and after a long time it will rush to the door

==Strategy & Tips==
U-5 can't kill the player, so just let it pass

==Trivia==
* '''U-5''' it's the same entity from the April fools '''U-5''' from Interminable Rooms.
* '''U-5''' is the 1st Interminable Rooms entity in game. The 2nd being [[A-258 (IR)]]
* '''U-5''' and [[CARDBOARD-5]] are the exact same entity. But one has a noticeable beige color making it look like cardboard hence the name [[CARDBOARD-5]]
